headline: Sensex, Nifty drop as RBI hikes repo rate to 5.5% and rules out rate cuts

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: RBI MPC hiked the repo rate to 5.5% and announced that rate cuts are off the table in the near term.
The Indian Rupee weakened significantly, falling towards record low levels against the US dollar.
Auto stocks dropped up to 3% following the hawkish rate signal from the central bank.
Broad selling pressure hit heavyweights like Titan and Shriram Finance, pulling Nifty below 22,600.
whatHappening: BSE Sensex cracked 300 to 500 points while NSE Nifty 50 slipped below the 22,600 mark.
Bharti Airtel hiked postpaid tariffs by Rs 50, driving its share price up over 2%.
L&T received initial approval for constructing the main part of a 1,600 MW thermal power plant in Jharkhand.
GE Aerospace shipped four F404-IN20 engines to HAL for the Tejas LCA Mk 1A project.
summary:
Indian equity markets declined sharply as the RBI hiked the repo rate to 5.5% and signaled that near-term rate cuts are off the table.
Auto stocks and consumer names faced heavy sell-offs, alongside the Rupee dropping near record lows against the U.S. dollar.
On the positive side, Bharti Airtel jumped over 2% on postpaid tariff hikes, while L&T and HAL picked up momentum on strong operational updates.
